content.text: Perfect! **Summary:** I resolved ticket T-5005 by identifying that Prometheus' persistent volume ran out of disk space at 03:02:44, causing WAL write failures and stopping metric collection. The logs clearly showed "no space left on device" errors. Since the storage class supports volume expansion, the fix is for the observability team to edit the PersistentVolumeClaim to request a larger size (e.g., 200Gi instead of 100Gi), which will automatically expand the ext4 filesystem without requiring a pod restart.
